## Topics

### Adrian's Parenting Challenges

  - [Adrian's daughter is struggling emotionally, possibly due to school stress and family changes](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=19.0)
  - [She's exhibiting frustration, anger outbursts, and separation anxiety](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=45.0)
  - [Adrian is exploring Waldorf school options and investigating potential MTHFR gene mutation](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=90.0)
  - [Co-parenting challenges with ex-partner's schedule changes and differing parenting approaches](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=322.0)

### Marc's Childhood Experience with Divorced Parents

  - [Parents divorced when Marc was 4 years old](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=386.0)
  - [Spent more time with mother due to work schedules, but had regular time with father](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=395.0)
  - [Initially missed mother when with father, but adjusted over time](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=505.0)
  - [Both parents found new partners relatively quickly, which helped normalize the situation](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=470.0)
  - [Stepfather provided positive experiences (outdoor activities, bonding)](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=568.0)

### Reflections on Childhood Impacts

  - [Adrian realized through therapy that childhood experiences significantly shaped his adult issues](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=601.0)
  - [Marc initially thought he had no problems from childhood, but recognized subconscious impacts](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=484.0)
  - [Both acknowledged the importance of processing childhood experiences](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=642.0)

### Content Creation Struggles

  - [Marc has been focusing on X (Twitter) growth but realized it's not aligned with his true goals](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=823.0)
  - [Adrian suggested repurposing long-form content (YouTube) into shorter posts for X](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=1016.0)
  - [Both struggle with perfectionism hindering content production](https://fathom.video/share/NwK2t5pLS-mUztxvKLnmtF4WLBFPeW9m?tab=summary&timestamp=1115.0)

### Spontaneous Podcast Idea
